entities.name: UniProt:B2A3N5
observations: Reviewed Natranaerobius thermophilus large ribosomal subunit protein bL25; query sequence has exact reference sequence hash match, 88.4% aligned coverage, and E-value 9.53e-128.
bL25 reference annotation: binds 5S rRNA and forms part of the ribosomal central protuberance; GO annotations include 5S rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation.
Sequence-derived properties for the 215-aa query: 24,267.5 Da predicted mass, pI 4.17, GRAVY -0.688, instability index 81.4; estimates assume unmodified full-length protein.
Pfam matches: Ribosomal_L25p PF01386.25 at residues 6–94 (i-Evalue 4e-21) and Ribosomal_TL5_C PF14693.12 at residues 103–184 (i-Evalue 3.2e-29).
